correctness.rationale: Exact rational identity makes the sign of K-uv a linear function of z in (0,1), with two sharp endpoints. CDF-TP2 follows from the exact mixed-log-derivative determinant and a sharp lower bound AB >= (1-t)^3, attained in a boundary limit, proving necessity and sufficiency. All parameter endpoints including p=1 and t=1 were considered. SymPy independently verifies critical symbolic identities and rational sign tests; no finite sampling is used for global proof.

value.rationale: Provides a complete motivated dependence phase diagram in a published two-parameter family: exact recovery from negative baseline to positive quadrant or CDF-TP2 order, an intermediate nonordered phase, a sharp transition contour and a precise boundary between two important ordering concepts. The theorem is not a routine unmotivated reparameterization and gives actionable conditions for choosing an appropriate copula dependence class.
